resources.string: Send any file, in a flash
Move photos, videos and big files between phones directly over Wi-Fi, with no internet and no data used.
Every transfer is encrypted and files are only accepted with your approval. Trust a device you know to accept from it automatically.
Move files to and from a computer\'s browser with nothing to install, over Wi-Fi or a USB cable.
Next we ask only for nearby devices and notifications, to find phones around you and show progress. We collect no data about you.
